title: Did You Know? Morocco at the Finals

slides.context: Morocco topped their group to reach the *last* sixteen — the first African side to advance at this level. [VERIFY]
In 2022 they reached the semi-finals, the *furthest* any African or Arab team has gone on the biggest stage. [VERIFY]
Their *debut* came in 1970, then a long wait before they became regulars at the finals. [VERIFY]
